label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink value is filter encoded via ESAPI.encodeForHTML() before writing to response; HTML encoding neutralizes XSS. Alert 2 (java/ldap-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is bar which derives from user-provided param (parameter name extracted from request), concatenated directly into LDAP filter '(objectclass=person)(uid='+bar+')' without sanitization. The LDAP filter receives attacker-controlled input enabling LDAP injection attack.

evidence.note: User input param derived from request parameter names
bar assigned from doSomething() returning user-controlled value
